name: Masling
abstract: A free, account-free classroom resource that teaches learners to infer word meaning from clue wording, answer length, grammar, context, and crossing letters. The guide provides a 20-minute routine, learning objectives, differentiation, discussion prompts, an exit ticket, a hint-first browser tool, and a downloadable reviewed dataset. It is independently written and does not reproduce complete commercial puzzles.
keywords: vocabulary, reading, context clues, word meaning, crossword clues, inference
